comment: Turns on Google Analytics 4 tracking via gtag.js.
modal: When **Yes**, the storefront loads Google Analytics 4 tracking through gtag.js. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Turns on Google Ads (AdWords) conversion tracking.

comment: The Google Ads conversion label reported when a conversion occurs.
